transforms.code:
system.util.getLogger("KPI").info("Home KPI load via runNamedQuery")
	data = system.db.runNamedQuery("Home/kpiSummary", {})
	top  = system.db.runNamedQuery("Home/kpiTopShort", {})
	def g(col): return int(data.getValueAt(0, col))
	openOrders=g("OpenOrders"); openSuppliers=g("OpenSuppliers"); asns=g("ActiveAsns")
	asnLines=g("AsnLines"); shipments=g("Shipments"); partsTotal=g("PartsTotal")
	partsShort=g("PartsShort"); belowLot=g("PartsBelowLot"); stocktake=g("StocktakeEntries"); suppliers=g("Suppliers")
	topShort = ("%s (qty %d)" % (top.getValueAt(0,"PartName"), int(top.getValueAt(0,"Qty")))) if top.rowCount else "none"
	def c(n): return "{:,}".format(n)
	return {
		"openOrders_num": c(openOrders), "openOrders_foot": "across %d suppliers" % openSuppliers,
		"asns_num": c(asns), "asns_foot": "%s ASN lines" % c(asnLines),
		"shipments_num": c(shipments),
		"partsShort_num": c(partsShort), "partsShort_foot": "of %d parts tracked" % partsTotal,
		"stocktake_num": c(stocktake),
		"rail_short_title": "%d parts at/below zero stock" % partsShort, "rail_short_meta": "Lowest: %s" % topShort,
		"rail_belowlot_title": "%d parts below one lot" % belowLot, "rail_belowlot_meta": "Master Data - review reorder",
		"rail_stocktake_title": "%d stocktake entries to review" % stocktake, "rail_stocktake_meta": "Stocktaking - cycle counts",
		"mod_orders": "%s open" % c(openOrders), "mod_shipasn": "%s ASNs" % c(asns),
		"mod_stock": "%d entries" % stocktake, "mod_master": "%d parts - %d suppliers" % (partsTotal, suppliers),
	}
